# Verify alternative scenario for m2
import datetime as dt
from freezegun import freeze_time

with freeze_time("2023-10-16 01:00"):
    tz_minus13 = dt.timezone(dt.timedelta(hours=-13))
    
    # Today in -13:00
    today_minus13 = dt.datetime.now(tz_minus13).date()
    print(f"Today in -13:00: {today_minus13}")
    print(f"UTC today: {dt.date.today()}")
    
    # Test date: 2024-03-16
    test_date = dt.date(2024, 3, 16)
    delta_aware = test_date - today_minus13
    delta_naive = test_date - dt.date.today()
    
    print(f"Test date: {test_date}")
    print(f"Delta from aware today: {delta_aware.days} days")
    print(f"Delta from naive today: {delta_naive.days} days")
    print(f"Threshold: {5 * 365 / 12}")
    print(f"Aware >= threshold: {delta_aware.days >= 5 * 365 / 12}")
    print(f"Naive >= threshold: {delta_naive.days >= 5 * 365 / 12}")
    
    # Check current naturaldate result
    import humanize
    aware_dt = dt.datetime(2024, 3, 16, 1, 0, tzinfo=tz_minus13)
    result = humanize.naturaldate(aware_dt)
    print(f"\nCurrent naturaldate result: {result}")
